question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

**Not make head or tail**

options.text: very boring and not at all fun

solution:
The correct answer is **'not able to understand anything.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**Let's understand the given idiom first.

 
• **The idiom "Not make head or tail" **is related to **the random decision-making process.**
